topic.title: Arnold Schwarzenegger took no salary to star in Twins and took a share of the film's earnings instead: how a $0 paycheck became the biggest of his career

title: Why did Arnold Schwarzenegger work on Twins for free? 🎬
description:
Arnold Schwarzenegger starred in Twins for no salary at all. So how did that film end up paying him more than any other?
Sources: A.V. Club (Jun 2025). The characters are not advisers.
Illustrative only. Not financial advice.
cta: A paycheck now or a cut later: which would you take? Comment

lines.text: Arnold Schwarzenegger said no to a salary for Twins. Why work for free?
And Danny DeVito and the director took no salary too.
So the studio made the whole film for just $16.5M.
Instead, the three took 40% of the film's earnings.
Then Twins made $216M at the box office.
And the money kept coming, from video tapes too.
Arnold says it paid him over $40M, more than 2.4× what the whole film cost.
A salary or a cut: which would you take? Arnold said no to the salary.

Beat 'backend' says the three took '40% of what the film earned after costs', and its COSTS sign covers the rest of the pie. 'After costs' is not sourced. Schwarzenegger (A.V. Club, 25 Jun 2025) says only '40 percent of the backend'. Wikipedia says '40% of the film's box office and rental' and Looper says '40% of the film's box office gross'; only SlashFilm says 'backend profit'. Fix: say '40% of the film's earnings' (or 'a 40% share of the film') and drop the COSTS-sign moment.

Other facts confirmed. $0 salary, 40% backend, $216M box office and 'over $40M' are on the A.V. Club page. NBC Bay Area (25 Jun 2025) confirms no salary and over $40M. $16.5M is Schwarzenegger's own figure on A.V. Club and within SlashFilm's $15-18M estimate. DeVito and Reitman sharing the 40% with no salary: SlashFilm and Looper. Home video earnings: SlashFilm. Disclaimer present. Style note: 'took nothing too' in beat 'chairs' could read 'took no salary too', since the next beat says they took 40%.
